upstream_runtime.original_locator: External VERIFY worktree, run-relative instances/VERIFY/FINAL_QUALIFICATION_V56/runtime/RETURN.json; exact alias retained in RAW_ARCHIVE_V17/INPUTS.json
upstream_runtime.result: V56 passed its replacement, mount/unmount, strict resource, camera and stability checks, then stopped on the separate unchanged-oracle source pin. Its runtime return is partial qualification, not a complete performance pass. Root accepted the passed resource subset; V20S owns the subsequent generator pin correction.

source_assessment: PipeViewport delta adds only the accessible toolbar wrapper; renderer creation, scene resources, demand scheduler, controls and disposal are unchanged.
App changes are responsive layout, concise proof display, palette destination handling and the new owned canvas-budget subscription. No renderer ownership is added.

Canvas-budget subscription owns one MutationObserver and one optional ResizeObserver. Its effect returns cleanup; cleanup disconnects both, removes its property and ignores queued callbacks after disposal. It schedules no animation frame or timer and avoids observing flexible canvas/dock allocations.

ToolkitPalette removes the untracked opener animation frame and document outside-pointer listener; the owned backdrop handles dismissal and focus. Styles alter layout and stacking rather than GPU ownership.

new_module_checks.coverage: Late mount, measurement insertion/removal and wrapping; bounded observation targets and no redundant style writes; both observer disconnections, queued-callback disposal, remount and no RAF scheduling.
new_module_checks.registered_selection: Unchanged vite.config.ts includes src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}; complete V95 desktop unit surface passed, along with all other registered surfaces.

decision: Retain the verified V56 owned-renderer baseline under exact unchanged resource implementation, plus reviewed and unit-tested lifetime guards for the added DOM observer. No new resource-sensitive defect or changed GPU ownership justifies repeating the broad resource cohort.
limits: No claim that the V56 binary is the final candidate or that its runtime was replayed.
Heap, browser RSS, renderer resources and native process RSS remain distinct measurements.
Constrained panel usability and complete performance qualification remain open; this applicability decision changes no timing threshold or owner gate.
